request.style: English, Norwegian revival song from the prayer house tradition, a warm female voice with a small congregation joining, accordion, acoustic guitar and a pump organ, gentle waltz in 3/4, inviting and tender, 88 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
You who struggle, you who carry
Heavy burdens day and night
Hear how Jesus calls you to him
You are not forgotten here

[Chorus]
Come to me, all you who are weary
And burdened, come to me
And I will give you rest
Come to me

[Verse]
Take my yoke and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart
And you will find rest for your souls
For my yoke is easy and my burden is light

[Chorus]
Come to me, all you who are weary
And burdened, come to me
And I will give you rest
Come to me
